key.name: key
key.description: React key for the rendered `Avatar`. Falls back to the item's index in `data`.

alt.name: alt
alt.description: Alt text for the image rendered when `src` is set.

href.name: href
href.description: Renders the avatar as a link to this URL.

status.name: status
status.description: Renders a status badge in one of the Chassis themed colors.

statusLabel.name: statusLabel
statusLabel.description: Accessible label for the status badge.

content.name: content
content.description: Content to render when `src` isn't set, e.g. initials or a "+5" overflow count.

component.name: component
component.description: Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component.
